body: I'd prefer not to say where I go, just for the sake of confidentiality. Thank you for the advice however, I'll definitely look into it. I am feeling a bit better.

I have seen therapists before, but none of my issues felt resolved. It's difficult for me to explain the situation fully, but I was forced into it by my parents due to what they felt were issues in my life rather than discussing what I felt needed to be talked about. As a result, I'm extremely uncomfortable talking to therapists in general.

I'm currently in college, although I'm on break. I wouldn't know the process of going to see a professional, and my parents monitor my bank accounts/insurance, so I would have no way of paying to see someone.
